5.4.2.1.3 Data Element with Extended Status
[SWS_Rte_06817]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈The data type for a data element with extended status (applies only for
PRPortPrototypes) shall be named Rte_DEX_<dt> where <dt> is the data ele-
ment’s ImplementationDataType name.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06818]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈A data element with extended status shall be a structure containing exactly
three members.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06819]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051
⌈The first member of each data element with extended status shall be
named ’value’.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06820]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The value member of a data element with extended status shall have the
type of the corresponding data element.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06821]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The second member of each data element with extended status shall be
named ’status’.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06822]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The status member of a data element with extended status shall be of the
Std_ReturnType type.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06823]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The third member of each data element with extended status shall be
named ’feedback’.⌋
[SWS_Rte_06824]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078, SRS_Rte_00185
⌈The feedback member of a data element with extended status shall be of
the Std_ReturnType
